caption:
Find your flow in Sayulita. 🧘

This town runs on good vibes, and nowhere is that more true than on the yoga mat. Whether you're a seasoned practitioner or just looking to stretch out after a surf session, Sayulita's yoga scene has you covered.

Rooftop shalas, jungle studios, sunrise sessions on the beach — every class here feels like a meditation. Teachers from around the world have landed here and never left.

Come for the waves. Stay for the practice. 🌺
